body: As I stand there, the sand swaying beneath my feet, I notice the line of shells is like nothing I've seen before. Their shape is unique, as if they've been eroded by the relentless waves into elongated, curved forms. I feel drawn to understanding what makes them tick, what could cause such a distinct shape.
